scope: Judge-only; no retrieval, indexing or answer generation.
controls: Same frozen cases, original answers, sources, gpt-5.4-mini/high, concurrency 4, per-call timeout 180 seconds, retries 0.
changes: Nested abstention schema allows only consistent flag combinations.
Clarify contrast-clause extraction and editorial attribution.
stopping_rule: One full calibration and one saved-answer batch. Preserve mismatches and pending cases; no prompt tuning to force agreement.
reviewer: Codex checks targeted source/answer/inventory comparisons; no independent human annotations.
acceptance_boundary: Schema consistency is deterministic; live semantic accuracy remains empirical and user acceptance is required.
